strings.zh: 劑量學 — 累積劑量、低劑量、間歇
致畸性與避孕規範細節
停藥後 laser / 手術 timing(更新觀念）
AAD 2024 acne guideline 整理(Isotretinoin 段落要點）
strings.en: AAD 2024 acne guideline summary (key isotretinoin points)

strings.zh: 間歇式(intermittent) — 每週 1 次或每月 1 週
歷史上有 Akman 等 protocol（每月吃 1 週），效果與成本介於 daily 與 low-dose 之間。臨床現況不普遍，reserve 給特殊耐受性差或長期維持的病人。
strings.en: Historical Akman protocol (one week per month) sits between daily and low-dose in efficacy and cost. Not widely used today; reserved for poor-tolerance or long-term maintenance patients.

strings.zh: 傳統 1986 年 Zachariae case series 建議停藥後 6-12 個月再做 ablative procedures；此後 6 個月成 dogma。
strings.en: The historical Zachariae 1986 case series recommended waiting 6–12 months after isotretinoin before ablative procedures; the 6-month rule became dogma thereafter.

strings.zh: 個案報告與小型研究有提及性慾下降、ED；機轉未明，可能與 sebum / mucocutaneous dryness 或 androgen 代謝有關。Practice：詢問、回報、必要時減量。
strings.en: Case reports and small studies mention decreased libido and ED; mechanism unclear, possibly related to sebum / mucocutaneous dryness or androgen metabolism. Practice: ask, document, dose-reduce if needed.

strings.zh: 嚴重 nodulocystic acne 對其他治療無效
strings.en: Severe nodulocystic acne refractory to other treatments

strings.zh: 治療失敗的中度 acne(antibiotic ± topical retinoid 3-6 個月）
strings.en: Treatment-failed moderate acne (after 3–6 months of antibiotic ± topical retinoid)

strings.zh: 有顯著 scarring 風險或 PIH 的中度 acne（AAD 2024 已將適應症擴大，不再強求 nodular）
strings.en: Moderate acne with significant scarring or PIH risk (AAD 2024 broadened indication beyond nodular)

strings.zh: 0.1–0.4 mg/kg/day(常見：每天 10-20 mg 固定劑量）
Meta-analysis(Rasi 2014, Borghi 2011)顯示 efficacy 與 standard dose 相近，但 mucocutaneous AE 顯著降低、生活品質較佳。
strings.en: Meta-analyses (Rasi 2014, Borghi 2011) show efficacy comparable to standard dose, but mucocutaneous AE rates lower and QoL better.

strings.zh: 常用於：成人女性持續性 acne、low-grade inflammation、患者強烈要求美觀。
strings.en: Common use: adult women with persistent acne, low-grade inflammation, patients prioritizing tolerability.
Optional: CBC, creatinine, glucose (based on patient comorbidity)

strings.zh: 確認近 1 個月內未使用 tetracyclines
strings.en: Confirm no tetracycline use in the past month

strings.zh: Dry eye、blepharoconjunctivitis、減少 night vision、contact lens 不耐
strings.en: Dry eye, blepharoconjunctivitis, reduced night vision, contact lens intolerance

strings.zh: 頭痛 + visual change → fundoscopy + 神經科會診
strings.en: Headache + visual change → fundoscopy + neurology consult

strings.zh: ALT/AST 輕度升高 ~ 10-15%，通常 < 3× ULN,reversible
strings.en: Mild ALT/AST elevation in ~10–15%, usually < 3× ULN, reversible

strings.zh: TG > 500 mg/dL → reduce dose / 飲食 / fenofibrate;> 800 mg/dL → hold(pancreatitis 風險）
strings.en: TG > 500 mg/dL → reduce dose / diet / fenofibrate; > 800 mg/dL → hold (pancreatitis risk)

strings.zh: 實務：詢問 baseline mental health；有 active major depression 者謹慎、監測 PHQ-9；出現症狀立即停藥評估。
strings.en: Practice: assess baseline mental health; caution and PHQ-9 monitoring in active major depression; stop and evaluate if symptoms emerge.

strings.zh: CYP3A4 inducers/inhibitors：臨床顯著性不大，因 iso 有多個代謝路徑。
strings.en: CYP3A4 inducers/inhibitors: minor clinical significance because isotretinoin has multiple metabolic pathways.

strings.zh: 建議 baseline + 第 2 個月 LFT/lipid；低風險者後續間隔可拉長。
strings.en: Baseline + 2-month LFT/lipid recommended; low-risk patients may extend intervals afterward.

strings.zh: 女性 CBP β-hCG 每月仍建議。
strings.en: Monthly β-hCG still recommended in women of childbearing potential.

strings.zh: Post-iso laser timing 採分層建議。
strings.en: Post-iso laser timing follows tiered recommendations.

strings.zh: Mental health screening 建議 at baseline,but 不支持「iso 直接造成 depression」的 causal claim。
strings.en: Baseline mental health screening recommended, but evidence does not support a direct causal link between isotretinoin and depression.

strings.zh: 食物（尤其脂肪）可使 AUC 增加 1.5-2 倍
13-cis-RA 自身對 RAR 的親和力低
strings.en: 13-cis-RA itself has low affinity for RARs

strings.zh: 唯一同時擊中所有四個
strings.en: the only agent hitting all four simultaneously

strings.zh: cumulative dose 達到 220 mg/kg 以上的病人 5 年復發率比 120 mg/kg 組顯著降低(~20% vs ~40%)
strings.en: Patients reaching cumulative doses ≥ 220 mg/kg show significantly lower 5-year relapse rates than the 120 mg/kg group (~20% vs ~40%)

strings.zh: 更高的 cumulative dose 可能進一步降低復發
strings.en: Higher cumulative doses may further reduce relapse
β-hCG (in women of childbearing potential, CBP)

strings.zh: routine monthly labs 對於低風險、年輕、無 comorbidity 病人 yield 極低
strings.en: Routine monthly labs yield very little in low-risk, young patients without comorbidities

strings.zh: baseline + 第 2 個月再驗 1 次，後續穩定者可拉長間隔
strings.en: Baseline + 2-month follow-up labs; intervals can be extended in stable patients

strings.zh: 標準 acne 療程罕見
過去 case-control 研究曾建議 association，但 2018 以後大型 cohort(Wright 2021、Lee 2016 et al.)及 systematic reviews 並未支持 causal link
strings.en: Older case-control studies suggested association, but large post-2018 cohorts (Wright 2021, Lee 2016) and systematic reviews do not support a causal link

strings.zh: 近年 large meta-analyses(Huang 2017、Ludot 2024)未支持因果關聯
strings.en: Recent large meta-analyses (Huang 2017, Ludot 2024) do not support causal association

strings.zh: 2 種避孕方式 ≥ 1 月 before、整個療程、停藥 ≥ 1 月
strings.en: Two contraceptive methods ≥ 1 month before, throughout therapy, and ≥ 1 month after discontinuation

strings.zh: 2017 ASDS expert panel(Waldman 2017)、2024 多份 systematic reviews 已重新審視：
strings.en: The 2017 ASDS expert panel (Waldman 2017) and 2024 systematic reviews have re-examined this:

strings.zh: 近期證據(Mysore 2017 et al.)支持治療中或停藥後即可，不影響 wound healing
strings.en: Recent evidence (Mysore 2017 et al.) supports treatment during or shortly after isotretinoin without impairing wound healing

strings.zh: 近年 propensity-matched cohorts(Wright 2021、Etminan 2013、Crockett 2010 reanalysis)未支持 causal association
strings.en: Recent propensity-matched cohorts (Wright 2021, Etminan 2013, Crockett 2010 reanalysis) do not support causal association

strings.zh: 長期高劑量（腫瘤科 neuroblastoma protocol、慢性 Darier 維持）
strings.en: Chronic high-dose use (oncology neuroblastoma protocols, chronic Darier maintenance)

strings.zh: scarring 或 PIH 風險高的 moderate acne
strings.en: moderate acne with high risk of scarring or PIH

strings.zh: 透過 NLRP3-independent FoxO/p53 axis 誘導 sebocyte apoptosis;sebum production ↓ 80-90%
strings.en: Induces sebocyte apoptosis via NLRP3-independent FoxO/p53 axis; sebum production drops 80–90%

strings.zh: 3-4 週起油脂顯著減少；為療效核心
strings.en: Sebum reduction visible from 3–4 weeks; central to efficacy

strings.zh: 透過 RAR-mediated 改變 K6/K16/profilaggrin 表達，降低 hyperkeratosis
strings.en: RAR-mediated modulation of K6 / K16 / profilaggrin expression, reducing hyperkeratosis

strings.zh: 不易產生抗藥性 — 與口服抗生素的關鍵差異
strings.en: No antimicrobial resistance — key difference from oral antibiotics

strings.zh: 降低 TLR-2 表達、減少 IL-1α / IL-8 / MMPs / neutrophil chemotaxis
strings.en: Down-regulates TLR-2 expression; reduces IL-1α / IL-8 / MMPs / neutrophil chemotaxis

strings.zh: 結節囊腫發炎快速消退
relapse 高風險（青少年男性、嚴重）
strings.en: High relapse risk (adolescent males, severe disease)

strings.zh: 成人女性、輕中度持續性、rosacea-like
strings.en: Adult women, persistent mild-to-moderate, rosacea-like presentations

strings.zh: 有 break-through 風險；需衛教

strings.en: Not recommended alone; suitable as secondary

strings.zh: 可,但 reliability 取決於 commitment
strings.en: Acceptable, but reliability depends on commitment
